lines: Magazine-style HTML report from any source (4 palettes)

card.summary: Magazine-style single-file HTML deliverable from any analytical source. Cover, chapters, severity meters, click-to-expand detail library, four editorial palettes.
card.paragraph: Content-agnostic generator. Turn any analytical brief — a blood panel, a GTM deck, a 10-K, an interview corpus, a renovation plan — into a printed-magazine-quality HTML file. Cover, TL;DR scorecard, finding cards with severity meters, targets table, action cards with pill badges, click-to-expand detail library, donut/bar charts, and a closing prediction band. Print-friendly, mobile responsive, self-contained.
use_when: Deliverable needs editorial polish, not a bulleted summary
Non-specialist reader must understand a domain deeply
You want a shareable, printable, point-in-time artifact
dontuse_when: Short answers, code review notes, or one-page summaries (markdown is enough)
You want a worktree change-log artifact → /stx-worktree-report

invocations.comment: Fully interactive — assistant runs the interview

rows: GTM plans, board reports, investment memos, audits

extras.title: Output
extras.html: Writes a self-contained .html file under the working folder (or topic-named subfolder). Returns the path + a 3-line summary in chat. Never commits.
